newsitem.title: USA: Omega and Vision in eye-care affiliation.
newsitem.headline: Omega and Vision in eye-care affiliation.

text.p: Omega Health Systems Inc and Vision Care Inc have agreed to an affiliation in providing eye-care services to their members, Omega said on Friday.

The agreement calls for Vision's Florida network of optometrists and ophthalmologists to provide comprehensive eye-care services to members of Omega's managed-care Eye Health Network. Omega's eye doctors will provide the same services for Vision's members in other U.S. states, Omega said.
Omega said Vision is the largest pre-paid vision-care plan in Florida, with more than 2.1 million members, 1,200 doctors and 600 contracting groups.
